name: RC-B10-0324/2025/REV1 – After § 1 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
part_text: 1a. Calls for the EU and China to use the upcoming summit as an opportunity to ease trade tensions and jointly revive multilateralism by advocating global trade rules guided by the principles of solidarity, cooperation, sustainability and democracy;
